ownership_rules.rationale: #401 explicitly names the platform core page, including its control/data-plane view.

#402 names ingress/egress/private networking and assigned operations; its Small task includes DNS, subnet boundaries and external entry. Networking hub, CIDR, LZA and domain procedures explain these routes, not Dapr or a dedicated ACR Path A–E experiment.
#403 explicitly owns Path A–E and diagrams associated with labs/acr-network-path-*. Generic registry authorization is not this five-scenario taxonomy.
These navigation pages reference the ACR Path A–E lab family in #403's referenced-docs scope; retain this candidate so reviewed overrides expose why generic navigation is owned by #406 instead.

#404's Small task includes job lifecycle, probes, deployment variants, replica counts and KEDA, beyond the directory list. Topic-aware matching includes probe-tuning and min-replica-change-impact and preserves typed job states.
#405 names identity, storage, security and Dapr/service-to-service plus assigned practices/operations. Registry authorization uses managed identity/RBAC, not #403's five network paths.
#406 owns diagnostic trees, query/evidence workflows and all labs; raw evidence assets are excluded separately. Dedicated Path A–E conflicts remain visible until overridden.

#407 scope: 'Residual diagrams in Start Here, Language Guides, Operations, Best Practices, Reference and supporting published assets not allocated to other migration tasks.' Language tutorials/recipes teach runtime implementation sequences rather than owning the platform component vocabulary.

#407 scope: 'Residual diagrams in Start Here, Language Guides, Operations, Best Practices, Reference and supporting published assets not allocated to other migration tasks.' Orientation, reference and authoring support the published guide; AGENTS sample and generated dashboards keep an administrative owner but are explicit migration exclusions.

#407 explicitly lists 'Operations' not allocated elsewhere. Reviewed telemetry, alerts, incident control loops and multi-region recovery are not revision/health-probe component diagrams even when their labels mention replicas.

#407 explicitly lists 'Best Practices' not allocated elsewhere. Mixed cost, availability, design and navigation judgments remain residual; diagram-specific reliability probe/Dapr overrides allocate the specialized views.

#407 scope includes 'supporting published assets not allocated to other migration tasks'; its title is 'remaining Container Apps guide visuals'. These explicitly reviewed resource-hierarchy, environment-capacity, hybrid and cost views are outside #401's single core page and the specialized migration tasks. Platform extension of that scope is an explicit interpretation, not a catch-all.
